# Periods

A FHIR `Period` is a pair of instants. A DHIS2 reporting period is a *typed* interval:
`202401` is the January instance of the `Monthly` type, and it is the type that makes the
period comparable, enumerable, and round-trippable back into DHIS2. The
`D2Period` extension carries all three facts.

## The D2Period extension

| Sub-extension | Cardinality | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iso` | 1..1 | `string` | The DHIS2 ISO period identifier, e.g. `202401`. |
| `type` | 1..1 | `code` | The DHIS2 period type, bound to `D2PeriodType_VS`. |
| `period` | 0..1 | `Period` | The date range the ISO identifier resolves to. |

Its context is the two resources that actually report over a period -
`QuestionnaireResponse` and `MeasureReport` - rather than a bare element. The `type` binding
is required, so a period this guide cannot resolve cannot be published.

## Period types

Every period type DHIS2 registers, with an example period and the dates that example covers.
The examples are resolved by the same parser the generated resources use, so a period type
and its ISO grammar can never disagree here.

| Type | Example | Span |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Daily` | `20251231` | 2025-12-31 to 2025-12-31 |
| `Weekly` | `2025W52` | 2025-12-22 to 2025-12-28 |
| `WeeklyWednesday` | `2025WedW52` | 2025-12-24 to 2025-12-30 |
| `WeeklyThursday` | `2025ThuW52` | 2025-12-25 to 2025-12-31 |
| `WeeklyFriday` | `2025FriW51` | 2025-12-19 to 2025-12-25 |
| `WeeklySaturday` | `2025SatW51` | 2025-12-20 to 2025-12-26 |
| `WeeklySunday` | `2025SunW52` | 2025-12-21 to 2025-12-27 |
| `BiWeekly` | `2025BiW26` | 2025-12-15 to 2025-12-28 |
| `Monthly` | `202512` | 2025-12-01 to 2025-12-31 |
| `BiMonthly` | `202506B` | 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31 |
| `Quarterly` | `2025Q4` | 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31 |
| `QuarterlyNov` | `2025NovQ4` | 2025-08-01 to 2025-10-31 |
| `SixMonthly` | `2025S2` | 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31 |
| `SixMonthlyApril` | `2025AprilS1` | 2025-04-01 to 2025-09-30 |
| `SixMonthlyNov` | `2025NovS2` | 2025-05-01 to 2025-10-31 |
| `Yearly` | `2025` | 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 |
| `FinancialFeb` | `2024Feb` | 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31 |
| `FinancialApril` | `2024April` | 2024-04-01 to 2025-03-31 |
| `FinancialJuly` | `2024July` | 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30 |
| `FinancialAug` | `2024Aug` | 2024-08-01 to 2025-07-31 |
| `FinancialSep` | `2024Sep` | 2024-09-01 to 2025-08-31 |
| `FinancialOct` | `2024Oct` | 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30 |
| `FinancialNov` | `2025Nov` | 2024-11-01 to 2025-10-31 |

The type codes above are the concepts of `D2PeriodType_CS`; see
[the CodeSystem](CodeSystem-d2-period-type-cs.html) for the ISO format
each one is written in.
